mission.title: Redpill Rescue Revisited
mission.description: Save a Zion team from attackers and get them to an extraction point.

npc.say: Did you bring Adele, Enceladus and Brest? They're due for extraction back to Zion.

phase.briefing: Warrior, the marauding imposter Agents are harassing our operatives with increased frequency. One of our teams near your location is under attack by unidentified assailants--Commander Lock believes that there may be more of these fake Agents. We need you to get in there, destroy the attackers and get our Zion team to safety!

enter.say: The team is in that building. Help them fight off the attackers, then get them to an extraction point.

talk.say: Who the heck are those guys with the bandannas on their faces?

done.say: Ah! It's the Zion team. Looks like you got there in time!

talk.say: These masked nuts showed up out of nowhere! Now that you're here, we should be able to take them out.
Ah, the smell of danger. Invigorating, isn't it?

done.say: Who could those masked thugs be? And what's this "sleep" they're talking about?

objective.text: Lead Adele, Enceladus and Brest out of the building

done.say: Excellent work getting the team out of danger. I knew you could do it!

objective.text: Do not let Adele, Enceladus or Brest die

phase.briefing: I'm updating your waypoint with the location of the extraction point. You're doing well so far, but stay alert! Zion's enemies may attack at any time.

enter.say: You're in the extraction point's building now.

objective.text: Lead Adele, Enceladus and Brest to the Zion Upgrade Master

done.say: You can leave the area, the extraction team will get them back to Zion.

objective.text: Do not let Adele, Enceladus or Brest die

complete.say: Ugh, there's nothing to do in Zion except sleep and eat. Boring!
Come look us up when you get back to Zion. We'll see about forming a mission team together.

mission.finish:
Great work, Warrior. Between those crazy masked men and false Agents, Zion really has its hands full these days. We're fortunate to have operatives like you championing our cause.
Contact me when you are ready for your next assignment.
